fee_notes: Standard fee $30,000; VetFran discount reduces to $20,000 for qualifying veterans (must own at least 50% interest). No initial franchise fee for renewals; renewals pay renewal fee. Acquiring existing franchised business requires $10,000 initial training fee instead. Pretraining Program and Initial Training fee is $2,000 additional.
raw_excerpt: Our standard initial franchise fee for new franchisees currently is $30,000.
